tiers.name: Mend the Old Pier
tiers.opens: The main pier and four berths, the harbourmaster's office, the Surf & Bait Shack and the dock-jobs board.
tiers.opens_gang: The main pier and four berths, the harbour office, the boardwalk vendor and the dock-jobs board.

tiers.name: Breakwater & Fish Market
tiers.opens: A stone breakwater, the fish market, the boatwright, inshore charters and the first boat passages.
tiers.opens_gang: A concrete breakwater, the fish market, the boatwright, inshore charters and the first quiet passages.

tiers.name: Deep-Water Berths
tiers.opens: The lighthouse lit again, the weekly trader ship, deep-sea night charters and world passages.
tiers.opens_gang: The harbour light back on, the weekly freighter, night charters and long-haul passages.

tiers.name: Grand Marina
tiers.opens: The yacht club, the trawler and free passages on every route.
tiers.opens_gang: The waterfront club, the trawler and free passages on every route.

hollis.name: Hollis Wade
hollis.pen: Hollis Wade taps his clipboard. 'Pier's half gone, lights are out. Fix her up and she'll pay you back.'
hollis.gang: Hollis Wade doesn't look up from the ledger. 'Harbour runs on favours. Bring planks, I'll find you berths.'

dabney.name: Dabney
dabney.pen: Dabney grins over a bucket. 'Worms, lures, crab bait! Fresh as this morning!'
dabney.gang: Dabney grins over a bucket. 'Bait, tackle, snacks. Boardwalk prices, honest ones.'

ines.name: Ines Ferro
ines.pen: Ines Ferro holds up a gleaming fish. 'Catch of the day pays a quarter more. Bring me that one.'
ines.gang: Ines Ferro wipes her knife. 'I buy fish, I don't ask where you cast. Catch of the day pays extra.'

cora.name: Cora Bell
cora.pen: Cora Bell brushes off sawdust. 'Every boat at this marina has my fingerprints on it somewhere.'
cora.gang: Cora Bell brushes off sawdust. 'Fast hulls, quiet engines. I build both.'

roz.name: Captain Roz Tern
roz.pen: Captain Roz Tern warms her hands at the fire. 'That's my camp. Rowed in last week. This harbour used to be something.'
roz.gang: Captain Roz Tern warms her hands at the fire. 'The Night Heron's mine. I take folk out past the lights. For a price.'

skipper.name: Skipper Barnacle
skipper.pen: Skipper Barnacle, the ferry-cat, flicks an ear. 'The colonies are out there. Hop aboard when you're ready.'

dutch.name: Dutch Calloway
dutch.gang: Dutch Calloway tips his flat cap. 'Tidewater Launch. Quiet passage, no questions, honest cargo only.'

saffi.name: Saffi
saffi.pen: Saffi leans on the Gull's Wing rail. 'Sea treasure for seeds and trinkets. One day only!'
saffi.gang: Saffi leans on the freighter rail. 'Rare stock, one day a week. Look fast.'

quests.title: Who Kept the Lights?
quests.ask: Light the dock lanterns: bring 4 lamp oil.

quests.title: Tangled
quests.ask: Bring 10 fiber so the nets can be mended.

quests.title: The Wreck's Log
quests.ask: Search the old galleon on three different days.

quests.title: Catch of the Day
quests.ask: Ines pays a quarter more for the day's fish.

quests.title: Shipshape
quests.ask: Repair the old ferry: 20 hardwood planks and 4 sailcloth.

quests.title: Quiet Cargo
quests.ask: Fix up the launch for honest cargo runs: 20 hardwood planks and 4 sailcloth.

quests.title: Light at the Point
quests.ask: Restore the lighthouse lamp: 8 glass and 6 iron bars.

charters.name: The Shoals
charters.intro: Roz throws a line round a post: 'The Shoals. Shallow, warm, full of fish. Cast anywhere.'

charters.name: Blue Deep
charters.intro: Roz kills the engine. 'Blue Deep. Mind the fog. The big ones come up at night.'

lantern.name: Lantern Boats
lantern.line: Paper lantern boats drift out from the main pier, one for every wish.

regatta.name: Regatta
regatta.line: Bunting on every mast: the marina regatta is on today.

derby.name: Fishing Derby
derby.line: Fishing Derby! Biggest fish on the pier by 2pm wins. Ines is judging.

harbour_lights.name: Harbour Lights
harbour_lights.line: Harbour Lights night market: neon stalls and ring toss all down the boardwalk.

pen.closed: The old pier creaks. A sign: 'Harbourmaster: see Hollis'.

gang.closed: Rotten pilings and a padlocked harbour office. A card: 'Ask for Hollis'.
